prompt: A clear editorial illustration split into two connected scenes: on the left, a sealed corporate AI factory feeds a large glowing neural-network “model” through hidden pipes labelled training data, code, methods and evaluations, with only a heavy crate of tiny numbered weight blocks rolling out through an open gate; on the right, many different people—researchers, a small business developer and an independent user—copy the crate’s contents onto their own computers, alter a few numbered blocks, and run adapted models, while a large server rack and specialised accelerator chip beside them show that access still requires substantial hardware.
